text:
nora: Quick huddle note  Optimize toolkit scope for next cycle. Two customer asks: eval-triggered regression alerts (PD + Console) and a tiny "batching helper" lib for flaky mobile. Proposal: ship alerts plumbing + PD hook + 3 starter templates, and a lightweight client snippet (JS/Kotlin). Defer quant profiles to post-beta. Agree?

ben: Agree. One ask: add a "quiet hours" toggle for PD delivery per tenant. Some customers want non-working-hour suppression.

sam: From UI: keep alert config to a template selector + numeric threshold + per-tenant enable. Inbox view: show trigger reason + attach sample prompts. I'll mock screens Thurs.

anya: ML side: we'll provide 3 templates (concordance_delta, auc_drop, failure_rate). Suggest threshold guidance and default sample sizes. Rule sketch:
```
if baseline_concordance - current_concordance > 0.05 AND sample_count >= 40 -> alert
attach: top_10 failing_prompts, last_10_outputs
```

leo: Infra notes: need per-tenant eval buckets, durable alert queue, PD/Slack webhook tester, and a canary toggle to enable alerts for internal + 2 beta tenants. KV cache telemetry will be added later for batching metrics. ETA for infra pieces: 3 wks if scope stays narrow.

nora: Acceptance gates (MVP): alerts fire on internal eval suite with reproducible samples; PD + Console delivery validated for 2 beta tenants; batching helper + snippets in docs; beta runbook + oncall assigned.

ben: CS: I'll handle beta invites and get PD webhook details from AcmeHealth. Also collect mobile connectivity traces from Zephyr for snippets.

sam: UI owner: me. Need /alerts/eval-diff?tenant=... API to populate inbox.

anya: I'll prepare eval packs and freeze templates by Monday.

leo: I'll add a canary flag and the webhook test endpoint. Will also emit a simple metric: alert_delivery_latency_ms.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Optimize toolkit - beta prep"  2025-04-08 09:00 PT. Invited: nora, ben, sam, anya, leo.

nora: Thanks team. Goal: beta handoff in ~5 weeks. Keep scope narrow; if anyone suggests adding quant recs or a full rule-builder before beta, flag it here. :rocket:
